notes.title: Update Notes - September 12th
notes.content:
Update Notes - September 12th
[olist]
Optimized the visual effects of objective location indicators and added sound effects to the mission system.

Improved performance issues related to lag in the late-game stages.

Enhanced the bullet hit detection and optimized the bullet firing process.

Fixed an issue where the purple lightsaber projectiles would fire in an incorrect direction at minimum speed.

Fixed an issue preventing the unlock of Steam achievements for the character "Nameless."
[/olist]

notes.title: MECHCRISIS IS OUT NOW ON NINTENDO SWITCH!

notes.title: May 13th Update Notes
notes.content:
Adjusted the wording of mission system notification texts

In auto-aim mode, dash-type skills will now execute based on mouse position or controller input direction

notes.title: April 27 Update Notes
notes.content:
4月27日更新说明：
亲爱的玩家们，下列为智械危机此次更新的内容。
1，Rewrote the code for implementing the "Bullet Time" buff item effect, as the previous version could potentially fail to restore the normal game time scale.

2，Added enemy-tracking bullet recognition for the auto-aim mode.
,3，Fixed an issue where the game would fail to detect controller input if a controller was plugged in after launching the game.

notes.title: Updated on November 5
notes.content:
Dear players, here's what we're all about this update.
This update includes an in-game rewarding quest system, which currently includes these quests:
1. Rush to the finish line, the character arrives at a certain place at the specified time,
2. Push the ball, use the ball to attack, and push it to a certain point
3. Chasing, the character chases a certain pattern
4. Break, break a certain number of spawned items
5. Poison Circle, escape from the Poison Circle
6. Survive in the circle, survive in the circle
7. Dodge rockets, which will drop rockets with attack judgments
8. The field of vision is reduced, and the player's field of vision will be reduced within a certain period of time
9. The body size becomes smaller, and within a certain period of time, the character will become smaller

notes.title: Update on September 24th:
notes.content:
Update on September 24th:
Dear players, the following is the updated content of Smart Weapon Crisis.
1. Create visual effects for some buff props by adding states of duration to the screen,
2. Color prompt for countdown text entering the store
3. Unlocking prompt function,
4. Improve the button settings of the controller
5. Increase critical strike damage mechanism
6. Add skills and components related to critical strike rate, as well as external skills
7. Add the function of recognizing local languages and automatically setting game languages,
8. Optimization of Strike and Feedback Sound Effects
9. The automatic firing and automatic aiming opening settings of firearms are set as default,
10. Adjusted the enemy stroke effect
11. The shopping mall and skill page selection boxes have been highlighted with some effects, as well as a button to confirm the purchase,
12. Add visual effects to the HUD to display the weapons currently owned and the weapons currently selected for use. By using the numeric keypad 1234 on the keyboard, you can quickly switch between the currently used weapons
If you encounter any bugs or have any suggestions, you can add to the official QQ group of PlaySmart Weapon Crisis, number 0: 947695991
Due to the fact that the game is a personal development with limited energy, many contents cannot be fixed immediately.
But I will respond promptly to all the questions you have raised and try my best to solve them.
Thank you all for your support of the game!

notes.title: Updated instructions on September 2
notes.content:
Smart Mechanic Crisis September 2 Major Update!
Hello players, this time there will be 21 content updates, several bug fixes, and improved the game experience.
Since the game is developed by individuals, the time and energy are really limited, and the game is not updated frequently. But the time that has not been updated, has been testing the game and optimizing the performance! I will continue to update the game in the future, and I hope you will bear with me.
The official version of the game will be available on October 1st! If you have any suggestions, you can add the official QQ group No. 0: 947695991. Thank you to all players for your support!
The specific updates are as follows:
1. Adjusted the rate of fire of shotguns and sniper rifles, and canceled the recoil of guns.
2. Added pickup items dropped by enemies, there are currently 2, one is to regenerate health, and the other is to increase the rate of fire for a short time.
3. Replace the image material of dropping gold and basic guns, pistols, shotguns, and sniper rifles.
4. Shop refresh, basically in a refresh does not repeat the same item.
5. Fixed the issue of using the spider drone bullet deflected left and right to flip.
6. Added a system to kill enemies to upgrade and gain skills.
7. Modified the map material of the first scene.
8. The store only opens automatically and refreshes automatically once per round.
9. Add a system to unlock weapons, bullets, and accessories as you progress through the level.
10. The music changes as you progress through the game.
11. The default button of the assembly interface is changed to Tab, the switch is changed to the Q key, and the pickup button is changed to the E key.
12. Added health bar display for bosses.
13. Added some enemy types.
14. Improved the logic of monsters, with the newly added enemies, and modified the waves of monsters.
15. Added 2 types of drops that provide different amounts of gold, and the probability of drops will change as the game progresses.
16. Added a trap for rocket attacks for the second map.
17. After a certain period of time, some random chests will be generated on the map, and there will be items with different instant effects, such as health regeneration, increased fire rate, etc.
18. After a certain period of time, some slot machines will be generated on the map that can be dropped, weapons and accessories.
19. The first boss will always drop a non-basic weapon.
20. Optimized the layout of the store interface, which can more clearly distinguish the rarity of various types of bullets/weapons/accessories.
21. Optimized skill selection, different types of skills will be distinguished by different color fonts.

notes.title: Intelligent equipment crisis major update on September 2nd!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this time we will update 21 pieces of content, fix several bugs, and optimize the gaming experience.
Due to personal development of the game, time and energy are indeed limited, and the update frequency was not high in the first few months. But before the update, I have been testing the game and optimizing its performance! I will continue to optimize the game and release new content in the future. I hope everyone can forgive me.
The official version of the game will be launched soon! If you have any suggestions, you can add to the official QQ group of "Intelligent Equipment Crisis" at number 0: 947695991.
Thank you to all players for their support!
The specific update content is as follows:
1. Adjusted the firing rate of shotguns and sniper rifles, and eliminated the recoil of firearms.
2. Added collectible items dropped by enemies. Currently, there are 2 items available, one for healing and the other for increasing firing rate for a short period of time.
3. Replace the image materials of dropped money and basic firearms, handguns, shotguns, and sniper rifles.
4. Store refresh, basically does not repeat the same item in one refresh.
5. Fix the issue of using spider drones with left and right deflection to flip bullets.
6. Added a system for killing enemies and upgrading to obtain skills.
7. Modified the map material for the first scene.
8. The store will only automatically open and refresh once in each round.
9. Add a system to unlock weapons, bullets, and accessories as the level progresses.
10. The music changes with the progress of the game.
11. Change the default buttons on the assembly interface to Tab, switch to Q, and pick to E.
12. Added health bar display for BOSS.
13. Added some enemy types.
14. Improved the logic for generating monsters, combined with newly added enemies, and modified the wave frequency for generating monsters.
15. Added 2 types of drops with different coin quantities, and the probability of drops will change as the game progresses.
16. Added traps for rocket attacks to the second map.
After a certain period of time, some random boxes will be generated on the map, with items with different real-time effects, such as healing, increasing firing rate, and so on.
After a certain period of time, some slot machines that can drop weapons and accessories will be generated on the map.
The first boss will inevitably drop a non base weapon.
20. Optimized the layout of the store interface, which can more clearly distinguish the rarity of various types of bullets/weapons/accessories.
21. Optimized skill selection, different types of skills will be distinguished by different colored fonts.

notes.title: Game Update for "MechCrisis" on May 17, 2024
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are pleased to announce the latest update for our game "MechCrisis", which will be released on May 17, 2024. This update brings the following new features and improvements to enhance your gaming experience:

1.Visual Effects Refinement
Improved lighting effects to enhance the overall visual quality.
Optimization of Late-Game Performance Issues
2.Various performance optimizations to improve game performance.
Ensures a smooth gaming experience even as the game progresses into the late stages.
3.Fixing the Issue of Bubble Bullets Not Exploding Upon Enemy Hit
Resolved numerous reported errors and issues to ensure a more stable and enjoyable gaming experience.
4.Adjustments to Certain Detailed Features
Made minor adjustments and optimizations to some features based on player feedback.
Aimed at further improving the overall game quality and player experience.

We hope these updates will provide you with an even better gaming experience. We will continue to work on improving "MechCrisis" to deliver the best entertainment experience for our players.

As always, we value your feedback and suggestions. Please feel free to share your thoughts with us, as this will help us continuously refine the game.

Enjoy the game!
The "MechCrisis" Development Team
